message.content:
No git history. Let me understand the bug better. The crash is a use-of-uninitialized-value in `set_cluster` called from `merge_out_clusters` called from `reorder_marks_arabic`.

In `merge_out_clusters`, it reads `out_info[start].cluster` and iterates over `out_info[i].cluster`. If `out_len` is less than `end`, then `out_info[end-1]` etc. would be reading uninitialized memory. But `merge_out_clusters(start, j)` is called with `j` being an index into `info` (the input buffer), not `out_info`. 

Wait, let me re-read. In `reorder_marks_arabic`, `start` and `end` are indices into `info` (the main buffer). But `merge_out_clusters` treats them as indices into `out_info`. This is the bug! The `merge_out_clusters` function operates on `out_info`, but `reorder_marks_arabic` passes indices into `info`. 

Actually wait, let me look at how `reorder_marks_arabic` is called and what `start`/`end` refer to.
